purpose: Version-matched expert review comparators for pipeline development. Curated cases are not a representative sample or a human correctness answer key.
leakage_control: Review generation receives only the submitted manuscript and independently version-matched supplements. Human reports, editorial letters, responses, quality notes and revised or published manuscripts are held out from generation.

entries.title: Group Membership and Deviance Punishment: Are Deviant Ingroup Members Actually Judged more Negatively than Outgroup Ones?
entries.version_evidence: The archive separates 2674-Manuscript.docx from revised manuscript and revision 2 files. The original DOCX was modified 2021-01-21, before the reviews completed 2021-02-16 and 2021-03-29. Both review the six-study manuscript and its feelings-thermometer and group-identification passages. The archive filename uses 2674; the project, article and document title establish its association with journal article 2764.

quality_screening.basis: Manual reading of each selected report and checks against the submitted text; substantive expertise and actionable criticism, not a correctness certification.
quality_screening.strengths: Reports connect operationalization and group identification to the inference, question within-subject analysis and scoring, and identify missing analytic documentation.
quality_screening.limits: Several proposed additions and manipulation checks are contestable; these are comparators, not correctness labels.

entries.title: Mortality salience effects fail to replicate in traditional and novel measures
entries.version_evidence: The archive explicitly separates the initial manuscript from revised-after-review and labels both reports Review 1. The original PDF was created 2020-09-30, before Nilsson’s dated 2020-11-09 report. Reports match the two experiments, H2 on page 6 and the power calculation on page 8.

quality_screening.basis: Manual reading of each selected report and checks against the submitted text; substantive expertise and actionable criticism, not a correctness certification.
quality_screening.strengths: Nilsson links distraction timing and operationalization to the theory and distinguishes nonsignificance from evidence of no effect. Fillon inspects preregistration and analysis files.
quality_screening.limits: Fillon contains a checklist annex and an overconfident summary of nonsignificance; power and difference-score advice needs critical assessment.

entries.title: Perceived morality of direct versus indirect harm: Replications of the preference for indirect harm effect
entries.version_evidence: Submission component 78k3g contains 2134-Manuscript in PDF-5310-1-4-20191024 (1).pdf; component gxchu is explicitly Review round 1. The manuscript has a 2019-10-01 PDF modification date and one OSF file version. Both reports quote the rating recoding, and Lakens identifies the same t(45)=0 comparison in the submitted table.

quality_screening.basis: Manual reading of each selected report and checks against the submitted text; substantive expertise and actionable criticism, not a correctness certification.
quality_screening.strengths: Reports identify incompatible rating descriptions, missing sample-size justifications and a concrete numerical comparison, while examining fidelity and interpretation of the replication.
quality_screening.limits: The claim that a t-test is categorically unacceptable for the recoded outcome is debatable. Keep the two reports separate; exclude the editor decision letter.

Schimmack quotes the original scalar-invariance explanation and the invariant-facets sentence; Epskamp’s page-10 and diagram comments match this tutorial version.
entries.genre: statistical tutorial with applied longitudinal data

quality_screening.basis: Manual reading of each selected report and checks against the submitted text; substantive expertise and actionable criticism, not a correctness certification.
quality_screening.strengths: Concise reports distinguish measurement invariance from substantive change and within-person from between-person inference, and critique model specification and instructional usability.
quality_screening.limits: Arrow-direction criticisms require the PDF diagrams; an extracted-text-only judge cannot establish those details. Requests for RI-CLPM extensions require proportionality assessment.

entries.title: Publication Bias in Meta-Analyses of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Interventions
entries.version_evidence: Submission component ts4ec contains 884-Manuscript in PDF-2309-1-4-20180608.docx; fgmux is Review Round 1 and a separate Review Round 2 component exists. The original DOCX was modified 2018-06-07. Both expert reports are in reviews_884.docx after the editor letter and quote its selection-model rationale, small-study counts and method-comparison passages.

quality_screening.basis: Manual reading of each selected report and checks against the submitted text; substantive expertise and actionable criticism, not a correctness certification.
quality_screening.strengths: Reports examine the power and assumptions of bias diagnostics, selection-model omissions, effect-size versus significance interpretation, and the feasibility of proposed sensitivity analyses.
quality_screening.limits: The initial manuscript is long and technical; external-method assertions and alternative aggregation advice are not automatically true. Exclude the editor letter from human comparators.
